bandReport.notes: Items 61-80, five per page (p14 = 61-65, p15 = 66-70, p16 = 71-75, p17 = 76-80). Item 61 begins at the top of p14 and item 80 ends at the foot of p17, so nothing spills past either band edge. COLUMN CROPS: on all four pages the c2 crop shaves the LEADING DIGIT off every right-column item number (64 reads '4.', 79 reads '79.' but 68/69/70/74/75/76/80 read as a bare '.', '5.', etc.); the body text of every right-column item is complete and the item numbers were confirmed from the whole-page pNN.png. Symmetrically, each c1 crop carries a narrow sliver of the RIGHT column's item numbers down its right edge (e.g. '64.'/'65.' visible in p14-c1) — a sliver of numerals only, no right-column text, so no attribution risk. All 20 items were read from the column images; the whole-page images were used only to confirm numbering. Item 70 prints a two-column Reservoirs/States pair grid, transcribed as a GitHub pipe table. Item 70's question line prints 'not' in bold italic ('are not correctly matched') — transcribed as plain text, emphasis not carried. Scan is ~150 DPI but legible throughout; no digit or single letter in this band was genuinely ambiguous. Item 71 stem ends 'in factories employing workers ?' with no number given for the worker threshold — that is what is printed, not a dropped figure.
